contradictions.fact: Season / water-availability window

claims.says: Jul-Aug (dry rock across all three summits; earlier season has more snow/rockfall risk, later season has minimal water)
Mid to late season (July-September) for water availability and less snow. Early season (May-June) offers better route definition with snow but requires avalanche understanding.
Water and conditions are the main cruxes—scout water availability before committing.
Water becomes critical crux in late season.

contradictions.why: season's own parenthetical and watch_out/pro_tips agree that LATE season (including Aug-Sep) has minimal/critical water, but best_season claims Jul-Sep is good specifically 'for water availability' and also recommends an early-season (May-June) window that season excludes entirely.
contradictions.internal_resolution: season + pro_tips + watch_out (3 fields) agree late season has a water shortage; best_season's 'for water availability' framing of Jul-Sep is the outlier and is likely wrong or mis-worded.

claims.says: IV

contradictions.internal_resolution: commitment and alpine_grade agree (both IV) and are the route's dedicated grade fields, so 'Grade III' embedded in the approach prose is likely contaminated text describing a different, easier line on the same peak.
